Frequently asked questions

Are these books tied to a specific denomination?

No. They speak to anyone seeking God beyond denominational labels.

Can they be read in any order?

Yes. Each book is self-contained. Start with the one that resonates with your current question.

Are they available in paperback?

Yes, paperbacks on Lulu. Ebooks on Payhip. Audio on Google Play. Links are on each book's page.

Are translations faithful?

Each version is reviewed by a native speaker. The theological meaning is preserved.

Ready to begin your journey? Choose the book that resonates — the first step changes everything.
